summary.text: Jason Goetz is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 119 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jason Goetz earned an associate degree from Barton County Community College in 2000.

His career experience includes working as chief learning officer of Goetz Farms Inc., interim lead pastor of Wilroads Garden Christian Church, and pastor of life mission with Dodge City Church of the Nazarene.
Goetz took office representing Kansas House District 119 on January 9, 2023, succeeding Bradley Ralph.
In the 2025–2026 session he chaired the K-12 Education Budget Committee and was assigned to the Appropriations Committee and the House Education Committee.
